items.stem: What is the main purpose of a custom GPT's instruction block?

options.text: To define the GPT's purpose, scope and behaviour clearly
options.rationale: Correct: instructions set purpose, scope and how the GPT should behave.

options.text: To store the conversation history permanently
options.rationale: Instructions configure behaviour; they do not store history.

options.text: To reduce the cost of each message
options.rationale: Instructions are about behaviour, not billing.

options.text: To replace the need for any testing
options.rationale: Instructions do not remove the need to test the GPT.

items.explanation: Correct: instructions set purpose, scope and how the GPT should behave.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: When should a custom GPT use an action or API call instead of a knowledge file?

options.text: When it needs live or frequently changing data the file cannot hold
options.rationale: Correct: actions fetch live data; knowledge files are static snapshots.

options.text: Always, because actions are better than files
options.rationale: Actions are not always better; static reference belongs in knowledge files.

options.text: Never, because files can hold any data
options.rationale: Files are static and cannot hold live or changing data.

options.text: Only when no knowledge files exist
options.rationale: The choice depends on whether data is live, not on file count.

items.explanation: Correct: actions fetch live data; knowledge files are static snapshots.

items.stem: Which TWO governance controls should be in place before sharing a custom GPT across a workspace? (Select TWO)

options.text: A named owner responsible for the GPT
options.rationale: Correct: a named owner is accountable for the GPT.

options.text: A review step before publishing or updating
options.rationale: Correct: review before release catches scope and safety issues.

options.text: Removing all instructions to keep it flexible
options.rationale: Removing instructions removes scope and control.

options.text: Giving every user edit rights by default

items.explanation: Correct: a named owner is accountable for the GPT.
